title: Security breadcrumbs: SOC2 prep + control mapping (scratch)
content:
PURPOSE / CONTEXT:
- Quick scratchpad for SOC2 prep: mapping high-risk areas we still need evidence for and lightweight automation ideas.
- Not a final artifact — will pull into confluence once cleaned.

CURRENT FOCUS AREAS:
1) Access management (IAM) — system accounts + key rotation
   - Questions: which services still have long-lived service account keys? (need inventory)
   - Evidence we have: IAM policies export (aws-iam-policies-2025.csv), sample audit log for a key rotation event (logs/rotation-2025-11.json)
   - Action: run one-off query to list non-rotated keys >90d. Samir to run by 2026-02-22.

2) Change control (deploy approvals)
   - Observed gap: some infra changes still only have a PR, not an approvals artifact.
   - Possible control: require at least one approver in CODEOWNERS + CI check that enforces approvals.
   - Evidence candidate: github PRs with approval history + CI pipeline artifact (pipeline-run-ids).
   - TODO: invent small script that pulls PR approvals for last 30 days to demonstrate enforcement.

3) Logging & monitoring: retention and access
   - Need clear retention policy for alert logs and who can access them.
   - Evidence: CloudWatch log group policies + S3 bucket lifecycle rules.
   - Acceptance criteria: retention >= 90d for infra logs; access limited to oncall + sec-team.

CONTROL MAPPING SKETCH (very rough)
- CC:Availability -> dedicated capacity autoscale policy doc (dedicated/autoscale-notes.md) -> owner: infra-eng
- CC:Change Mgmt -> GitHub PR approval + release checklist (release-engineering) -> owner: release-eng
- CC:Logical Access -> IAM roles + OKTA groups -> owner: platform-eng

EVIDENCE INVENTORY (what we can reasonably produce quickly)
- IAM role listing export (csv) — generate via aws iam list-roles -> PRETTY FAST
- Service account key age report -> run script; attach to evidence bundle
- PR approval history for past 90 days -> GitHub API export (json)
- KMS key policy snapshots -> current + previous (for rotation proof)
- Oncall rota / pager duty export -> prove separation of duties

OPEN QUESTIONS / RISKS
- Are there any legacy on-prem systems that don't forward audit logs? If yes, need compensating control.
- How do we prove encryption-in-transit for internal RPC between containers? Nginx/TLS termination + service mesh? Need config dump.
- Data classification: do we have an authoritative list of repos that process PII? (I think product-data team owns but not documented)

SMALL AUTOMATION IDEAS (MVP-level)
- Lambda to scan for long-lived keys and open a Jira ticket for owner -> low-friction evidence (ticket links)
- GH action that snapshots PR approval state to a JSON file and uploads to S3 (timestamped)
- Periodic export of CloudTrail to a secured bucket with lifecycle and an MD5 checksum file (prove immutability-ish)

NOTES TO SELF / NEXT STEPS
- 2026-02-19: draft short email to release-eng + infra-eng asking for owners for the listed controls.
- 2026-02-22: Samir to run key-age scan and paste results here.
- 2026-02-25: Jin to prototype GH action for PR snapshots (if time).
- Merge final mapping into confluence page: confluence:SOC2-control-mapping-7890 (target 2026-03-10).

SAMPLE QUERY SNIPPET (for log/key scan)
- AWS CLI (rough):
   aws iam list-access-keys --user-name SERVICE_ACCOUNT_X --query 'AccessKeyMetadata[?CreateDate<`2025-11-01`]'
- GitHub approvals (curl):
   curl -H 'Authorization: token $GH' "https://api.github.com/repos/redwood/infra/pulls?state=closed" | jq '.[] | {number: .number, merged: .merged, approvals: .requested_reviewers}'

DOCS / REFERENCES TO ATTACH LATER
- Confluence control index (link TBD)
- SOC2 prep checklist from external auditor (pdf)
- Sample evidence bundle format (zip template)

RACI (rough)
- Owner: infra-eng for IAM controls
- Responsible: platform-eng (implement fixes)
- Consulted: legal, product-security
- Informed: gtm + executive (for high-impact findings)

UNRESOLVED ITEMS / NICE-TO-HAVE
- Automated evidence registry UI (for auditors) — long-term, deprioritize for now
- SLA for producing ad-hoc evidence requests (target: 48 hours)

END NOTES:
- Keep this doc ephemeral. Will extract definitive artifacts and move to shared drive / confluence.
- If you are reading this and think "we already have that", append a line with the artifact link and date.

-- Elena M.
